title: A question the owner asked twice gets answered, and the write still lands
replays: The 29 Oct class: the owner's question was ignored, then a wrong answer came back as the daily nugget.

history.text: By the way, what time does the village library close on Saturdays?

steps.text: You did not answer me: what time does the village library close on Saturdays? Also log my snack: a granola bar, 210 kcal.
